snippet.title: AMIT THE PAPERMAN- REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
ITS TIME TO TEAR THINGS UP! 

Its peaceful on the planet of Papercury until a malicious pig named President P Porks decided to take over the planet for himself. Nobody likes that one bit, especially one AMIT THE PAPERMAN! Smash though foes with the PAPER TORNADO, Speed through all types of enviornments, and find all the PRISTINE PENCILS in AMIT THE PAPER MAN!

Demo releases on september 11th on Itch.io and #Sage2026. Look forward to it!

#itchio #Sage2026 #sonic #kirby #wario
